_comment: Pinned public datasets for B3. Checksums are the Dataverse-published MD5 values (dataset metadata API). Raw logs are never committed: /ml_pipeline/data/* is gitignored.

eclog.licence: CC0 with additional terms (see Dataverse terms of use); derived features only are committed

eclog_1day.tab.note: Dataverse-ingested tabular version; this is what the published MD5 covers

eclog_1day.csv.note: uploaded original (input of label_eclog.py); Dataverse publishes no checksum for it, so its SHA-256 is recorded on first download and its rows are checked against the verified .tab

eclog.access: Dataverse guestbook 356 (name, email, institution, position required) gates every file download; anonymous API download is refused (HTTP 400 guestbook error, or 403 for some clients). Download in a browser from https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/Z834IK and place the files in ml_pipeline/data/raw/ under the names below; fetch_datasets.py then verifies them.

zanbil.licence: Restricted on Dataverse; access request and API token required; never redistributed
